text: Rainy season... and the whole colony is bored!
Rainy selfie! A million likes incoming!
Zero likes? Even Mummy didn't!
Food pic! Samosa always goes viral.
I was hungry!
Captain Croc's boat! Super fast!
Arey! My Captain Croc!
Quiet! Not near the drain!
Chill! I have an idea!
A little bigger... bit more... done!
Ten minutes, ten thousand likes! I'm a star!
Who needs a real crocodile?
Did you hear? Croc in the drain!
Forty groups! One breath! My record!
In ten seconds, the whole colony knew.
Yes, yes! Telling you both!
Masterji! Crocodile!
Mosquito? Use a net, then!
Croco... dile? Oh, my dhoti!
Evil eye! Even crocodiles need lemon-chilli!
Science says: rain-crocs eat only chappals!
Doors shut! Windows shut! Bathroom drain shut!
I have an idea! Let's go!
Idea in pocket. Homework out.
Don't fear! I fear nobody!
If the croc comes... straight to the pavilion!
A c-c-croc cub!
Enough! I'll handle this.
Pooja... gone? Really gone?
My son is a lion! Whole colony will see!
Tonight... I will guard the gate!
Umm... actually... that photo...
Quiet! Don't say bad things!
Papa... scared of a frog?
Midnight... Sharma gate... on guard.
I fear nobody... except sleep.
W-who's there? Come out!
<sigh> Only a cat. Scared me!
C-c-croc!
Ramesh beta, why are you hanging at midnight?
Yoga, Masterji! This is called... Gate-asana!
Did you hear? Ramesh is hanging!
Croc-proof gumboots! Bite, and teeth break!
Yesterday one hundred. Today three hundred!
Seth, your teeth beat the croc's!
Not one rupee less!
She took one? Give me two!
Then three!
Four for me! Colony will see!
Let's go, let's go! Barefoot is cheapest.
Seth! Bring more stock?
One, two, three... again... one, two...
Biscuits inside the boot! What an offer!
Biscuits extra! Twenty rupees!
Listen, everyone... that crocodile, actually...
Next! Join the line!
Two p.m... croc hunt, live!
Hello friends! We're live! Croc hunt!
Science says, crocs come for whistles.
Seth, you go first. You're... senior.
Me? My boots are three hundred!
Everyone listen! That croc isn't real...
It... it... it's moving!
Crocodile!!!
...isn't.
Arey! That's my chappal!
See? Science! Croc spat it out!
Bindu! Pull!
Did you hear? Croc spat a chappal!
Views double! Chappal's viral too!
<sigh> My photo... now bigger than a chappal.
Havaldar! Crocodile!
Pakoras, Havaldar.
Huh? Where? Enquiry will be!
Crocodile or its father... there will be an inquiry!
Shh... the law is coming.
Cro-croc... small... green...
Evil eye!
Pakora?
Inquiry... continues...
My Croc... gone.
I have an idea! No fear, inquire!
Call the Forest people!
Quiet!
Hello, Forest Department? Crocodile in the drain... maybe.
I'll handle snacks.
Breaking news! Crocodile in colony drain!
Our drain on TV! Whole colony will see!
Cool, cool, chill... no, panic!
Whole colony on rooftops. On the road... only the buffalo.
Let's go! Forest sahib has come!
Every time! At the most important moment!
Shabaash! You're the real mechanic!
Where is the crocodile, no? Show me.
There!!!
The whole colony held its breath...
I fear nobody... I fear no...
Crocodile? Ish, this is rubber, no?
So small? What of my gumboots?
My Captain Croc! Found you!
But in the photo it was big!
Can I say? This photo has three mistakes.
Fact-check, we're live!
One: cat's shadow... not a croc's!
Two: croc bigger than drain! How'll it enter?
Science says, crocs hold breath and go thin!
Shh!
Three: Laddu's teeth on its tail!
That... I was hungry.
Crocodile tears, heard. Crocodile photo, first time!
Who took this photo?
Yes... I made it. Only for likes.
Likes?!
Dadi's aim... never misses.
And I forwarded to forty groups unseen.
My three hundred boots... who'll buy now?
Seth!
Okay, okay... one hundred. Old price.
And I did gate-asana all night!
Enough! I'll handle this. Who made the drain famous...
...will clean it!
Cool, cool, chill... too much tension.
We're live! Drain cleaning, episode one!
Correction goes to forty groups... but check first!
Any biscuits inside?
My chappal! See? Science!
Inquiry... complete. Case closed.
Evening came, rain stopped... and the drain sparkled.
One fake photo... and the whole colony on rooftops.
Dadaji, just a joke...
The joke was yours. The fear was the whole colony's.
How do we know the truth, Dadaji?
Can I say? Who sent, shadow, size - check first.
Doubt? Don't forward! Report lies!
Think before you forward...
...or one day, truth will look like lies.
Phew! No more crocodile-shocodile.
Papa! Something's really in the drain!
Yes, yes... crocodile. Enough now.
I fear nobody!
